**The University of Jordan**  
**الجامعة الأردنية**

| Course No. | Course Title                            | Number of credit hours |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------|------------------------|
| 04413134    | Qur'an Recitation skills and Teaching   | 3                      |

**Prerequisite course:** 0431213

This course provides students with a set of advanced concepts and skills in recitation and intonation of the Holy Qur’an, from both a theoretical and applied skill standpoint, and advanced training skills commensurate with the needs of the labor market. The student studies how to employ the science of stopping and starting to clarify the meanings of verses when reading them, and the ability to judge discussions, warnings, and individual Hafs readings, and the path of Qasr al-Mufassil from the path of Taybah. The student is also trained in the skills of holding courses, methods of teaching Tajweed, and memorization circles in mosques, schools, and Qur'anic centers for beginners and advanced students. This is applied to topics in the science of Tajweed that were studied in the courses on the provisions of reading the Qur’an 1 and 2, along with memorizing Surat Al-Baqarah and mastering its reading by heart with the rulings. And reading eight parts of the Holy Qur'an from a licensed sheikh.

---

| Course No. | Course Title          | Number of credit hours |
|-------------|-----------------------|------------------------|
| 0401111     | Qur'anic Sciences     | 3                      |

**Prerequisite course:** None

This course encompasses an introduction to the Qur'an, exploring various aspects such as its revelation, reasons for revelation, Makki and Madani verses, the method and duration of revelation, and its place and time. It also covers the writing and translation of the Qur'an, the miraculous nature of the Qur'an, its abrogated and abrogating verses, preservation from distortion, and refutation of doubts. The course further addresses Quranic sciences, including recitations and reciters, and fundamental principles to be considered in interpretation.

---

| Course No. | Course Title          | Number of credit hours |
|-------------|-----------------------|------------------------|
| 0401121     | Hadith Sciences       | 3                      |

**Prerequisite course:** None

This course covers all aspects of the sciences of hadith, including the status of the Sunnah, the narration and documentation of hadith, the sciences of narrators, the sciences of the text, the sciences of the chain of transmission, variations in narrations, accepted and rejected hadith, and the study of two books in the sciences of hadith, one classical and the other contemporary, particularly the book "Methodology of Criticism in the Sciences of Hadith."
